description: Loria hosts various experimental platforms. These platforms provide high quality experimental environments fostering cutting-edge research for many teams.

platforms.name: Creativ'Lab
platforms.description: A unique place for innovation, where multiple research activities converge in fields such as drones, additive manufacturing, acquisition of multimodal data around humans and robotics.

platforms.name: High Security Laboratory
platforms.description: Hosts ground-breaking research on secure networks, internet communications and the associated telecommunication equipment. This major European-level research laboratory focuses on three main expertise fields.

platforms.name: Grid 5000
platforms.description: An experimental computer infrastructure made out of large scale computation grids, aiming to promote research in the field of grid computing, service infrastructures, peer-to-peer systems, networks and the next generation Internet.
